title: Trivia
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy sets an ambitious sales goal to double growth to eight percent by the end of the quarter and motivates the office to participate in a trivia contest in Philadelphia to help close the sales gap. Dwight pursues a managerial position in Sabre's printers division and meets with Robert California, who ultimately rejects him for the job. The Dunder-Mifflin staff divides into teams for the trivia night, facing challenges including Ryan's disqualification for using his phone. The trivia competition progresses with the Einsteins team winning the game, while Andy remains hopeful about meeting the sales goal. The episode ends with Andy encouraging the group and sharing a crude animation he made, leaving some outcomes uncertain.
